titre: La pénurie de mémoire frappe Android, pas iOS
sous_titre: Variation des expéditions mondiales de smartphones en 2026, en %

Marché mondial.texte: worldwide smartphone shipments will fall 16.7% in 2026 to just over 1 billion units

Android.texte: Android bears almost the entire decline, falling 24.3% in 2026

iOS (Apple).texte: shipments remain relatively resilient, down just 1.3% YoY in 2026
